read_flow_middlebury: read a .flo optical flow file in Middlebury format and return a numpy array
write_flow_middlebury: write optical flow data to a .flo file in Middlebury format with u and v channels
read_flow_kitti: read a KITTI format optical flow PNG file and return the flow array and validity mask
write_flow_kitti: write optical flow data to a KITTI format PNG file with validity mask
read_gen_generic: read image or flow files by extension including .png .flo .pfm .bin and .raw formats
